meta.title: Extend Submission Time is offered on a live RFQ where Vendor An and Vendor B have bid
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with Vendor A and Vendor B bids.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the test tenant.
Navigate to the live RFQ stage where its Settings menu is available.
Open the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Assert the action is offered and clickable while bidding is live.
Perform the requested hover over the menu action.
Select the enabled action to open its time-extension window.
Assert that the extension window opened.
Cancel without confirming any time change.
Verify the extension window closed without applying a change.
